meta.title: YesYes – a dating app just for sex. Agreed and safe.
meta.description: YesYes is a dating app just for sex, for verified adults. Blind agreement, a safety mode with someone you trust, SOS and a duress PIN. Coming soon to Prague.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Four steps. Only one more than on a regular dating app – and that's the one that makes the difference.
how.step1Text: ID and a selfie with a verification service. Everyone is who they say they are. We don't keep your ID.
how.step2Text: Just like anywhere else. When you both like each other, it's a match and you can chat.
how.step3Text: Each of you marks what you're into on your own: yes, maybe, no. You only see what you both agree on.
how.step4Text: Turn on safety mode. Someone you trust knows where you are, and the app checks that you're OK.

blind.title: Say what you're into. You'll only see the match.
blind.text: No awkward haggling in the chat and no pressure like "but you ticked it". What one of you doesn't want, nobody sees – not even who didn't want it.
blind.point1: Yes, maybe or no – for each activity separately.
blind.point2: Condoms, staying sober, the place and a safe word are agreed upfront.
blind.point3: You can say no to anything once you're there. No explanation needed.
blind.mockHidden: What one of you doesn't want, nobody sees.

safety.title: During your date, someone knows.
safety.lead: One tap turns it on. The other person only sees that you have it on – which is a deterrent in itself.
safety.trustedText: Gets a text with a link to your location and the status of your date. Nothing more.
safety.checkinText: Confirm with your PIN that you're OK. If you don't, our server sends a text – even if your phone is dead.
safety.sosText: Hold the button and the person you trust gets an alarm with your location right away.
safety.duressText: It looks exactly like your normal PIN on screen. But it quietly raises the alarm.
safety.fakeCallText: Your phone rings in 30 seconds. An excuse to leave if you're not feeling it.
safety.discreetText: On your home screen it looks like a notes app, and notifications give nothing away.

consent.quote: No means no. Even if you agreed in the app.
consent.point1Text: It's a plan, not a promise. Consent only counts here and now, and you can take it back at any time.
consent.point2Text: The agreement's details are deleted 48 hours after the date. They're kept only if the person reporting a problem wants them kept.
consent.point3Title: Cross a boundary and you're out
consent.point3Text: Everyone has a verified identity, so a ban applies to the person, not just the account.

pricing.title: Free at launch. Safety forever.
pricing.text: Right now YesYes is completely free. Paid extras like unlimited likes or boosts will come later. Verification, the agreement and safety mode will always be free.
pricing.free3: Safety mode, SOS and duress PIN
pricing.free4: Reporting and help after a date

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Is YesYes really just for sex?
faq.a1: Yes. No looking for a relationship and no pretending. If you're after something else, you'll find it elsewhere.
faq.q2: Why do I have to verify my identity?
faq.a2: So everyone is who they say they are, and a ban applies to the person, not just the account. A specialist service does the check; we only keep the result, your date of birth and an encrypted fingerprint – never your ID.
faq.q3: Who sees what I picked in the agreement?
faq.a3: Nobody. The other person only sees what you both agree on. Your "no" stays yours.
faq.q4: What if something goes wrong on a date?
faq.a4: Hold SOS, or enter your duress PIN, which looks like the normal one. The person you trust gets an alarm with your location. After the date, the app offers places to get help.
faq.q5: Will people around me know I use YesYes?
faq.a5: They don't have to. You can switch to a discreet icon, notifications give nothing away, and the app locks with your face or fingerprint.
faq.a6: Nothing at launch. Safety stays free after that too.
faq.a7: We're starting in Prague. More cities will follow based on the waitlist.
faq.a8: No. YesYes is for people over 18 only, and we check it against an ID.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.r1: Adults with a verified identity only.
rules.r2: Consent can be withdrawn at any time – even during a date.
rules.r4: No paid services and no photos without consent.
rules.r5: Reporting a serious violation suspends the account immediately until it's reviewed.
rules.r6: If we suspect a crime, we work with the police.

privacy.title: Waitlist and privacy
privacy.text: For the waitlist we only store your email, city and language so we can send you an invite. Your email is encrypted, we don't share it with anyone, and we delete it after launch unless you create an account. You can ask us to delete it at any time by emailing {email}.

footer.help: Need help after a date? Contact your local police or a victim support line.
